The Morning News Call newsletter :
World stocks fell on Monday as worries about softening demand for the iPhone dragged down shares of Apple Inc AAPL.O and persistent trade tensions between China and the United States sapped investor sentiment.
At 11:48 ET, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 1.32 percent at 25,076.87. The S&P 500 was down 1.32 percent at 2,700.1 and the Nasdaq Composite was down 2.28 percent at 7,082.573.
